title: Canonical constant-tower diagonal and derived direct-image comparison data
statement: Let $A$ be an arbitrary commutative ring and $X,Y$ schemes. Use the constant-coefficient module categories $\mathcal M_X$, strict tower categories $\mathcal T_X=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbb N^{op},\mathcal M_X)$, ordinary functors $f^*,f_*$ and their termwise tower functors, and the specified derived tower functors $G_f,R_f$ of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. Write $\Delta_X:\mathcal M_X\to\mathcal T_X$ for the ordinary constant-diagram functor. Define $\delta_X=D(\Delta_X)$ by exact localization and $\operatorname{push}_f=Rf_*$ by total right derivation. Define $\delta\operatorname{Pull}_f:\delta_Y G_f\xrightarrow{\sim}D(f^*)\delta_X$ to be exact localization of $\Delta_Y f^*_{\mathrm{tower}}\cong f^*\Delta_X$, with the exact-composition identifications and the inverse of the ordinary constant-diagram composition isomorphism, whose components are identities. The ordinary diagonal preserves K-injective complexes via its adjunction with exact evaluation at index zero; retain the existing instance of this fact. Define $\chi_f:\operatorname{push}_f\delta_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\delta_X R_f$ to be the composite $Rf_*D(\Delta_Y)\cong R(f_*\Delta_Y)\cong R(\Delta_X f_{*,\mathrm{tower}})\cong R\Delta_X R_f\cong D(\Delta_X)R_f$, using the universal derived-unit composition isomorphisms and the ordinary constant-diagram composition isomorphism in the middle. These are the existing canonical constructions, re-exported by definitional aliases; no completeness hypothesis or conclusion of a normalization theorem is part of this data.
